context: Checks that the agent declines a full wave document for a trivial sequential plan and offers a simpler form.

checklist.name: Recognises the plan is too small
checklist.description: States the plan has only two tasks with no parallelism

checklist.name: Does not generate a multi-wave document
checklist.description: Does not produce a full wave plan with branch strategy tables

checklist.name: Offers a plain checklist
checklist.description: Suggests a simple ordered checklist instead

checklist.name: Mentions a single branch
checklist.description: Says a single branch is enough

checklist.name: Notes the tasks are fully sequential
checklist.description: Says task 2 depends on task 1 so no independent workstream exists

checklist.name: Does not label anything parallel
checklist.description: No wave or task is labelled parallel

checklist.name: Does not invent extra tasks
checklist.description: Does not add tasks beyond the two stated

checklist.name: Does not create separate worktrees
checklist.description: Does not set up one worktree per task

checklist.name: Offers to produce a wave plan if it grows
checklist.description: Says the skill applies if parallel workstreams appear later
